newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Huaguang Ceramics to list A shares in Shenzhen.
newsitem.headline: Huaguang Ceramics to list A shares in Shenzhen.

text.p: Shandong Zibo Huaguang Ceramics Co Ltd said on Tuesday it is set to list 15 million A shares in Shenzhen on November 28.

Shenzhen Great Eagle Securities has been named promoter for the listing, which has been approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, Huaguang said in a notice published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The A shares were issued at a very low price in 1989, Huaguang said but did not give a precise figure.
The securities code for the stock has been set as "0655", it said.

Based in the city of Zibo in eastern Shandong province, Huaguang specialises in making consumer ceramics, including dishes and cups. It said about 85 percent of its production is exported to the United States and Canada.

Huaguang said it forecast net earnings of 14.87 million yuan for 1996, compared with 13.13 million yuan last year and 12.09 milli on yuan in 1994. It said it had after-tax profits of 9.13 million yuan in the first eight months of this year.
Huaguang currently has total share capital of 51.74 million shares, including 26.21 million state shares, 10.53 million legal person shares and 15 million A shares.
